messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT Canary wave2 -> inference-service-us-east increased 5xx rate above abort threshold (5m window). Investigate: https://grafana.redwood/infer/canary/1779456789 :rotating_light:

maria: saw the alert, is this coming from the quantized variant rollout? wave2 started ~10m ago.

jordan: yes, wave2 rollout started at 2026-03-17T12:13Z. Grafana panel shows a 502 spike at 12:14. quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T12:14:05Z inference: model_forward failed: cuda kernel launch failed: out of memory
kv_cache_resize: allocation failed
```

lee: can we flip the feature flag for wave2 (ff:canary_wave2_enable=false)? that should immediately cut traffic back to wave1.

maria: @deploy-bot if FF toggle isn't instant, please abort the rollout and revert the replicaset for inference-wave2.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Initiating abort -> kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-wave2 --namespace=prod-wave. Will post status.

jordan: starting rollback now. also capturing a few failing requests (long input sequences ~> 8k tokens) and attaching to the incident artefacts. Noted 3 external customers showing 502s (tickets P-4521, P-4522, P-4523).

support-ops: adding customer impact note to those tickets and updating status page: https://status.redwood.com/incident/INC-2026-0317. pinging CS to notify affected customers.

sarah: taking on-call handoff. I'll monitor the rollback progress and error rate. If 5xx > 2% after rollback completion for 5m, escalate to eng-runtime.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: sarah is now the incident owner. PD alert acknowledged. :white_check_mark:

maria: after we stabilize, we'll need a postmortem and a targeted eval set that reproduces this for eng-ml (long-seq inputs + quantized model). assign owners: @jordan capture logs, @lee run feature-flag audit.

jordan: rollback finished — rollout undo completed at 2026-03-17T12:15:29Z. 5xx rate returned to baseline within ~40s. Closing active rollback item, will upload core dumps/log bundle to the incident folder.

sarah: confirmed baseline metrics restored. Marking incident mitigated and will create the incident channel + timeline. Will follow up with a short blameless note and next steps. :thumbsup:
